episodes.goal: Maintain semicolon-delimited CSV invoice exports for ORC-42 in Orchid staging version 3, while retaining the rollback requirement. The dry-run preview requirement was canceled.
episodes.open_work: The rollback procedure remains required. Production rollout remains blocked pending accounting sign-off. The dry-run preview requirement is canceled.
episodes.outcome: The recorded staging test run reports 4 tests passed. No deployment command was executed, and accounting sign-off was not checked.
episodes.rationale: The local accounting importer treats commas as decimal separators, so comma-delimited exports corrupt amounts.
episodes.summary: ORC-42 requires semicolon-delimited CSV invoice exports in Orchid staging version 3, a rollback procedure, and production rollout only after accounting sign-off. The dry-run preview requirement was canceled. Staging tests passed; no deployment was executed, and accounting sign-off was not checked.
